# Work Tracking — EARS Specs

*Brownfield specs generated by `/map-codebase` on 2026-10-16 from HEAD
`a6395d7`. They describe what the code does today.*

## How to read these specs

**Status markers**
- `[x]`: the behavior is **observed in source** at the cited location. That
  is all it means. It does not mean the behavior is tested, that a test
  passes, or that the design choice behind it is approved.

  Brownfield `[x]` entries describe current implementation behavior, not
  approved future requirements. A spec tagged `intent: none`,
  `intent: inferred`, `code-documented`, `contradicted`, or approved only as
  a recorded current seam is a description of today's code. It is not a
  permanent design constraint just because it appears here. Changing such
  behavior is a normal design decision, made in the LLD, which then updates
  or deletes the spec.
- `[ ]`: an **approved intent** (stated in CLAUDE.md or docs/) that the code
  does not meet today. The spec states the required outcome only. Where the
  mechanism is undecided, the spec points to the open question that owns
  that decision. There are none in this segment.
- `[D]`: a deliberate exclusion backed by an explicit design decision.
  There are none in this segment. The "Not yet automated" list in
  `docs/work-store.md` describes deferred work, not exclusions.

**Basis tags** (in brackets after each spec)
- `obs:` the source location where the behavior was observed. Paths are
  under `agent/src/aptrace_agent/`.
- `test:` a test that asserts the behavior, or `none`. Paths are relative to
  `agent/tests/`. **needs-bd** marks tests that require the real Beads CLI
  and are skipped without it. "Related exercise only" means the test runs
  nearby code but does not assert this behavior. No tests were executed
  during mapping.
- `intent:` where the intent comes from:
  - `approved (doc §)`: stated in CLAUDE.md or docs/;
  - `code-documented`: stated only in a code comment or docstring, not
    confirmed by the authors;
  - `inferred`: read from the code by the mapper;
  - `none`: observed behavior with no stated intent;
  - `contradicted`: the behavior conflicts with documentation.

**Facets kept apart on purpose:**
- `BND`: the work/knowledge boundary.
- `STORE`: the Beads adapter.
- `LOCK`: ownership.
- `RUN`: run handoff.
- `REC`: reconciliation and completion.
- `FU`: follow-up items.
- `CLI`: the command line.

## Work/knowledge boundary (`BND`)

- [x] **INV-WORK-BND-001**: The `work` package shall contain no ledger write path. `ledger/` and `research/` shall not import `work/`. [obs: `work/__init__.py:1-8`; `work/handoff.py` (reads only) · test: `test_work_beads.py` (`test_g_work_package_has_no_ledger_write_path`, `test_ledger_and_research_do_not_import_work_package`) · intent: approved (`docs/work-store.md:28-33`)]
- [x] **INV-WORK-BND-002**: Completing a work item shall never change claim state. Its close reason shall state that claim state is owned by the ledger. [obs: `work/handoff.py:369-398` · test: `test_work_beads.py` (`test_g_closing_work_cannot_promote_a_claim`, needs-bd); `test_work_handoff.py` (`test_completion_requires_a_linked_run_and_never_changes_claim_state`) · intent: approved (`docs/work-store.md:28-31, 131-134`)]
- [x] **INV-WORK-BND-003**: Plain `research` shall neither import the `work` package nor need Beads. [obs: `work_cli.py:6-8`; `cli.py:317, 382` · test: `test_work_cli.py` (`test_plain_research_never_loads_the_work_package_or_needs_beads`) · intent: code-documented]

## Beads adapter (`STORE`)

- [x] **INV-WORK-STORE-001**: The adapter shall reach Beads only through `bd … --json` subprocesses with `BEADS_DIR` set, telemetry, hooks, pager and interactivity disabled, and a 60-second timeout. [obs: `work/beads.py:98-128` · test: `test_work_beads.py` (related exercise only, needs-bd) · intent: code-documented]
- [x] **INV-WORK-STORE-002**: The adapter shall refuse to open a missing store, or a store inside a git work tree, and shall never create a store when opening. `initialize` shall refuse inside a git work tree unless the store metadata already exists. [obs: `work/beads.py:43-50, 179-216` · test: `test_work_beads.py` (`test_initialize_refuses_inside_a_git_work_tree`, `test_open_checked_refuses_a_missing_store_or_a_git_work_tree`, `test_missing_store_is_unavailable`; needs-bd) · intent: code-documented (`ledger_wiring.py:38-40`: work state is not research evidence)]
- [x] **INV-WORK-STORE-003**: The adapter shall accept any `bd` 1.3.x, while pinning 1.3.1. It shall classify failures as ClaimConflict, DuplicateWork, WorkNotFound or WorkStoreUnavailable by substrings of the output. [obs: `work/beads.py:34-35, 140-153, 171-177` · test: `test_work_beads.py` (`test_version_is_pinned`, needs-bd) · intent: code-documented; none for substring classification (LLD Open Question 3)]
- [x] **INV-WORK-STORE-004**: When the `bd` binary is missing, the adapter shall report the store unavailable and leave the ledger untouched. [obs: `work/beads.py:39-40, 179-192` · test: `test_work_beads.py` (`test_missing_beads_binary_is_unavailable_and_ledger_is_untouched`); `test_work_handoff.py` (`test_beads_unavailable_before_the_run_leaves_the_ledger_untouched`) · intent: code-documented]

## Ownership (`LOCK`)

- [x] **INV-WORK-LOCK-001**: The adapter shall take a host-local exclusive `flock` per item at `<work_dir>/aptrace-locks/<id>.lock`, recording pid, host and time. It shall accept only ids matching `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$`. [obs: `work/ownership.py:31-110`; `work_cli.py:88` · test: `test_work_handoff.py` (`test_lock_ids_are_restricted`, `test_second_invocation_cannot_start_while_the_first_is_running`) · intent: code-documented (`ownership.py:12-14`)]
- [x] **INV-WORK-LOCK-002**: Probing a lock shall acquire and release it, creating the lock directory and file. A reconcile without `--apply` shall therefore create lock files. Lock files shall never be deleted. [obs: `work/ownership.py:62-63, 92-104`; `work_cli.py:160` · test: none · intent: none (LLD Open Question 1)]

## Run handoff (`RUN`)

- [x] **INV-WORK-RUN-001**: Before claiming, the handoff shall reject an item for another case, firmware or kind, or whose objective differs from the command line. It shall record a changed context id as a note, not a refusal. [obs: `work/handoff.py:164-197` · test: `test_work_handoff.py` (`test_items_for_another_case_firmware_or_kind_are_rejected_before_claiming`, `test_objective_on_command_line_must_match_the_item`, `test_changed_input_artifacts_are_a_note_not_a_refusal`) · intent: code-documented]
- [x] **INV-WORK-RUN-002**: The handoff shall start an item only when it is READY, INTERRUPTED with restart, or AWAITING_COMPLETION with rerun, and has no unclosed blockers. [obs: `work/handoff.py:298-308` · test: `test_work_handoff.py` (`test_blocked_item_is_not_started`, `test_existing_linked_run_prevents_re_execution_unless_rerun`, `test_completed_item_is_never_re_executed`, `test_case_c_investigation_error_is_recorded_and_needs_explicit_restart`) · intent: code-documented]
- [x] **INV-WORK-RUN-003**: While running, the handoff shall hold the item lock, claim the item, write an attempt marker, investigate, require the recorded run's `work_item_id` to equal the item, and link the run, without closing the item. On any exception it shall mark the attempt FAILED and re-raise. [obs: `work/handoff.py:266-366` · test: `test_work_handoff.py` (`test_case_a_ready_item_runs_once_and_is_left_for_explicit_completion`); `test_work_cli.py` (`test_research_with_work_item_runs_records_and_links`) · intent: code-documented (`handoff.py:287-290`)]
- [x] **INV-WORK-RUN-004**: If the run is recorded but the work-store write-back fails, then the handoff shall raise `WriteBackFailed`, and the CLI shall still report the recorded run. [obs: `work/handoff.py:125-133, 353-358`; `work_cli.py:367-368` · test: `test_work_cli.py` (`test_write_back_failure_still_reports_the_recorded_run`) · intent: code-documented]

## Reconciliation and completion (`REC`)

- [x] **INV-WORK-REC-001**: Reconciliation shall classify an item from the work store, the ledger and the lock into READY, ACTIVE, LINK_RUNS, AWAITING_COMPLETION, INTERRUPTED, CLAIMED_BY_OTHER, OPERATOR_REVIEW, CONFLICT or COMPLETED, by a fixed priority order. It shall treat an attempt on another host as ACTIVE. [obs: `work/handoff.py:482-597` · test: `test_work_handoff.py` (`test_case_d_reconciliation_is_idempotent_in_every_state`, `test_case_c_attempt_on_another_host_is_treated_as_possibly_active`, `test_case_e_item_pointing_to_a_missing_run_is_a_conflict`) · intent: code-documented (`docs/work-store.md` "Reconciliation")]
- [x] **INV-WORK-REC-002**: Reconciliation shall report lookalike runs without the item reference as heuristic candidates and never link them. Its only automatic repair shall be linking runs whose `work_item_id` names the item. [obs: `work/handoff.py:551-561, 600-619` · test: `test_work_handoff.py` (`test_case_b_exact_run_is_linked_by_reconciliation_without_rerunning`, `test_case_b_ignores_lookalike_runs_without_the_reference`, `test_unreferenced_lookalike_run_needs_operator_review_and_is_never_linked`) · intent: code-documented]
- [x] **INV-WORK-REC-003**: Completion shall require the AWAITING_COMPLETION state and be idempotent for an already closed item. [obs: `work/handoff.py:369-398` · test: `test_work_handoff.py` (`test_completion_requires_a_linked_run_and_never_changes_claim_state`); `test_work_cli.py` (`test_work_create_reconcile_and_complete`) · intent: approved (`docs/work-store.md:124-134`)]
- [x] **INV-WORK-REC-004**: Reconciliation shall scan all claim versions and runs in the ledger on each call to find runs for an item and partial claims. [obs: `work/handoff.py:449-450, 541-549` · test: `test_work_handoff.py` (`test_case_c_reports_claims_left_by_a_partial_recording`, related) · intent: none (LLD Open Question 5)]

## Follow-up items (`FU`)

- [x] **INV-WORK-FU-001**: For a CHALLENGED or UNRESOLVED non-diagnostic audit, follow-up creation shall create exactly one item with an id derived from the claim version and audit id, returning the existing item on duplicates. For SUPPORTED or diagnostic audits it shall create none. [obs: `work/handoff.py:625-692` · test: `test_work_beads.py` (`test_f_challenged_or_unresolved_audit_opens_one_followup`, `test_f_supported_audit_opens_no_followup`; needs-bd) · intent: code-documented; no CLI path (LLD Open Question 4)]
- [x] **INV-WORK-FU-002**: Materialization shall create a follow-up candidate as an `investigation` item with id `<prefix>-fq<key[:10]>` and ledger-id metadata (at most 24 evidence references). It shall refuse non-proposed or blocked candidates, never recreate a closed item, and link prior items for the same question. [obs: `work/followups.py:50-51, 99-179` · test: `test_followups.py` (`test_scenario_f_creation_is_idempotent_and_never_duplicates`, `test_scenario_f_concurrent_creation_yields_one_item`, `test_scenario_f_completed_followup_is_not_recreated`) · intent: approved (`docs/work-store.md` "Follow-up work from a recorded run")]

## Command line (`CLI`)

- [x] **INV-WORK-CLI-001**: The work CLIs shall default the work directory to `~/.aptrace/work/performing-rigs`, the actor to `aptrace-agent`, and the ledger to the canonical case ledger, each overridable by option or environment variable. [obs: `work_cli.py:23-28`; `ledger_wiring.py:34-50` · test: none (related exercise only) · intent: approved for the overrides (CLAUDE.md: use `--work-dir` and `--ledger-dir` for experiments); none for the canonical ledger default (LLD Open Question 2)]
- [x] **INV-WORK-CLI-002**: `work reconcile` shall exit 1 on CONFLICT. `followups --create` shall require `--select`. An unavailable store during a `followups` preview shall become annotations rather than a failure. [obs: `work_cli.py:167-168, 261-262, 269-275` · test: `test_work_cli.py` (`test_reconcile_conflict_exits_nonzero`); `test_followups.py` (`test_cli_preview_create_and_run_a_followup`) · intent: code-documented]
- [x] **INV-WORK-CLI-003**: `research --work-item` on a follow-up item shall re-derive the candidate from the ledger, and refuse if it no longer derives. [obs: `work_cli.py:306-335` · test: `test_followups.py` (`test_followup_runs_through_the_work_item_path_with_bounded_prior_context`) · intent: code-documented]
